name: Newtonian Gravity Between Bodies
description: Mutual gravitational attraction between all target bodies (N-body), with optional softening.
script:
# F_i = Σ_j G m_i m_j (r_j − r_i) / (|r_j − r_i|² + ε²)^(3/2)
force = sum_of(others, G * self.mass * it.mass * (it.com - self.com) / (dot(it.com - self.com, it.com - self.com) + param.softening^2)^1.5)
